study: Query-level relative learning support and exposure normalization
problem: Within-bag state contrasts alone have no feedback in four settings; RMOT also needs between-candidate preference for the same query.
proposed_objective: Condition on same-video/query/effective-view with at least2observations and an actual teacherYes>=.5; KL between normalized positive teacher evidence and predicted profile, using confidence divided by own bag-view state count.
safeguards: No conditional target from allNo strata; teacherYes is not groundtruth. Bernoulli output allows multiple targets. No atom-wise or bag-negative pseudo labels.
mathematical_checks: Common prediction-scale invariance given eligibility/weights, exact duplicate-observation mass invariance, allNo zero profile loss, and nonzero between-candidate gradient.
empirical_checks: All4 fixedpolicies xall6settings, own actual QA only; counts of supported cross-candidate/within-bag groups and teacher variation, not accuracy.
future_quality_controls: Strong unbalanced ordinary; exposure-balanced pointwise; same-context direct model; no-profile and profile-permutation controls. No HOTA/parameter choice in this audit.
